title: Round-6 prompt XOR: prompt_file-only step no longer demands a prompt (agent/llm/llm_map)
evidence: EXECUTED configErrors() directly against the real module (node, type-stripped, real zod). agent | llm | llm_map, prompt key DELETED + prompt_file:'prompts/task.md' -> errs.prompt === undefined (no prompt error) for all three. Same for prompt:'' / '   ' / null alongside a file. Matches validate.rs:681-695 exactly (has_prompt = prompt.filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).is_some(); has_file = prompt_file.is_some(); MISSING only on !has_prompt && !has_file). CLOSED.

title: NEITHER-case copy survives the XOR byte-for-byte

title: Empty-string / whitespace prompt_file is treated as 'has a file' — defensible, matches the backend
evidence: EXECUTED: prompt_file:'' and prompt_file:'   ' with no prompt -> NO prompt error on all three kinds. This MATCHES validate.rs:682 (has_file = prompt_file.is_some(); Some("") is_some() == true) so the client does not contradict the backend, which is the stated contract of promptSuppliedByFile. Separately confirmed the backend itself also does not flag an empty prompt_file at install (check_prompt_files, validate.rs:1083-1090: '' contains no '..', does not start with '/', and bundle_root.join("") canonicalizes to the root itself) — that is a PRE-EXISTING backend gap on origin/feat/agent-core, untouched by this branch, and DESIGN.md §3 puts backend validation changes out of scope. Not a finding against this diff.
verdict: defensible; upstream gap noted, out of scope

title: BOTH (real prompt + prompt_file): the client is silent, it does not contradict WORKFLOW_PROMPT_BOTH

The backend emits WORKFLOW_PROMPT_BOTH, which reaches the author through the panel (attributeFindings -> humaniseFinding) and blocks Save via WorkflowBuilderPage.tsx:60,68 (hasErrors from validation.errors). title: A prompt_file: step still shows a red required '*' on an empty, NOT-required box, and the surface never says the wording comes from a file (INV-6)
evidence: Round 6 removed the FALSE error but not the FALSE requirement marker beside it. PromptField is called with a hardcoded `required`, and LabeledControl renders that as ` *` (builderFields.tsx:60). promptSuppliedByFile (stepForms.ts:216) is the ONLY consumer of prompt_file anywhere in the UI — verified by `grep -rn prompt_file` over components/builder/ + stores/: no form reads it for `required`, and no control, description or badge mentions the file. So on an imported prompt_file: workflow (reachable: get_workflow_definition, handlers/mod.rs:112-127, returns the parsed WorkflowDef with prompt_file intact) the author sees 'What should the assistant do? *' over an empty textarea, no error, a green panel and an ENABLED Save — a silent degradation with NO stated reason, which DESIGN §2.5/INV-6 forbids. FAILURE MODE: the asterisk is the only statement left about that field and it is false; obeying it (typing the task) produces prompt+prompt_file -> WORKFLOW_PROMPT_BOTH -> Save blocked, i.e. the marker walks the author into the exact trap round 6's reworded WORKFLOW_PROMPT_BOTH copy exists to walk them out of. Bounded: recoverable by clearing the box, backend catches it, no data loss (toWorkflowDef spreads steps so prompt_file round-trips intact). NOTE the three call sites are in files this branch does not modify; the DIVERGENCE is created by the round-6 hunk (stepForms.ts:207-218), which lifted the requirement on one side only. Fix is `required={!promptSuppliedByFile(step)}` plus a one-line description naming the file.
verdict: residual of round 6's own target; INV-6 AT-RISK

title: promptSuppliedByFile is derived per render from the step, not latched — no stale-mode class of bug

Nothing can desync when prompt_file appears or disappears under a sync refetch. Store-side: WorkflowBuilder.store.ts's toBuilderDef/toWorkflowDef pass step objects through whole (lines 52, 66), so prompt_file is neither dropped on load nor on save.

title: No timer, subscription, promise or process introduced by round 6; the session-scoped catalog remains sound
evidence: configErrors is a synchronous pure function — round 6 adds no async work, no listener, no cleanup obligation. Re-checked the pre-existing lifecycle machinery it sits beside: the WeakMap session state keyed by the builder store, the shared `pending` promise so a late joiner awaits rather than re-fetches, the per-key generation counters that discard an in-flight answer after invalidate, and the store's per-instance validateTimer (WorkflowBuilder.store.ts:253-267) which is closure-local so it cannot leak across concurrent builders. defineLocalStore auto-unsubscribes the two sync listeners on unmount.
